adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Jobs::PollFeed` with `sidekiq_options retry: false` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). Since `poll_feed` performs network I/O via `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` (and parsing) without any rescue, transient network/HTTP errors will cause the job run to fail and Sidekiq will not retry that run. While it will run again on the next hourly schedule, this is a reliability/robustness concern rather than a strictly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
